title: ERL Digital Screens 2026 — KLIA Ekspres Station & In-Train Network
summary: Station coverage network RM35k/mo per spot (32 totems); in-train network RM30k/mo per spot (190 screens across 16 trains).
description: ERL KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit digital network (10 + 9 pages). Quick facts: 6 stations, 18 trains, 57km of track, 7.5M annual ridership, 5am–12am service every 15–30 minutes, 28–38 minutes end to end. Station Coverage Network: 32 x 65-inch digital totems at KL Sentral (18), Putrajaya/Cyberjaya (4), KLIA T1 (6) and KLIA T2 (4); 15-second spots; maximum 8 advertisers; RM35,000 per spot per month. In-Train Network: 190 x 26/27-inch digital screens across 16 trains; 15-second spots; maximum 8 advertisers; RM30,000 per spot per month. Rates exclude 8% SST.
